goal: Stop the HTTP server from executing requests pipelined behind a closing connection
Prevents clients from accidentally duplicating RPCs with side effects when retrying unserved requests
agreement: Substantive concept support with no open objections
Concept approval because the issue was also flagged by an internal red team (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it prevents duplicate execution of RPC calls with side effects
Clients retrying unserved requests after a connection close would otherwise trigger repeat operations
